title: John Mack and Terence McKenna on the Western paradigm bursting open

tellings.quote: John Max says oh it's gonna it's G to burst open and we're all going to realize that the Western Paradigm is incredibly myopic and closed

plain: The idea here is that the Western way of seeing reality is about to break open, and that people will come to see it as "incredibly myopic and closed." Michels tells it himself, crediting the line to John Mack, a Harvard psychiatrist who studied people reporting alien encounters, and putting it beside Terence McKenna, a writer on psychedelics, and Thomas Kuhn, the philosopher who wrote about how scientific worldviews get overturned. If they are right, much of what Western science rules out would be back on the table.
